rules.title: A cache key names every input it depends on
rules.text: A cache key lists everything the cached value is a function of: a key that omits one input serves the answer computed for a different question, and the miss is invisible because the entry looks warm.

judgement.question: Does this key, or this call that builds it, name every input the cached value is a function of, or does an input that changes the answer go unmentioned?

criteria.true: an input the cached value depends on is absent from the key or from this call to it
criteria.false: the key and this call carry every input, or this is not a cache key and not a call to one
